items.name: GenerateKey
items.doc: GenerateKey returns a random 32-byte Ed25519 seed (the private key).
items.summary: GenerateKey returns a random 32-byte Ed25519 seed (the private key).

items.name: PublicKey
items.doc: PublicKey returns the 32-byte public key of seed.
items.summary: PublicKey returns the 32-byte public key of seed.

items.name: Sign
items.doc: Sign returns the 64-byte Ed25519 signature of msg (RFC 8032).
items.summary: Sign returns the 64-byte Ed25519 signature of msg (RFC 8032).

items.name: Verify
items.doc: Verify reports whether sig is a valid signature of msg by pub.
items.summary: Verify reports whether sig is a valid signature of msg by pub.
